title: Silence phantom
description: Removes the annoying phantom screeches for peaceful nights in Minecraft.
body:
goodbye to the endless screeches of phantoms 👻🌙. This resource pack removes all phantom flying and screaming sounds 🔇, giving you peaceful nights without the constant noise. Phantoms will still spawn and behave normally — only their sounds are silenced.

Perfect for players who enjoy late-night building 🏗️ or exploring without being disturbed. No more jumpscares when you forget to sleep!

Features:

Removes all phantom sounds except their in-game presence.

Works from Minecraft **1.17 up to 1.21+**

Lightweight ⚡ and easy to install — just drop it in your resource packs folder 📂


Created **By AmirMiner 🛠️**
